description:
SLO Sharks is a team of curious students passionate about space, science, and technology. Fascinated by the mysteries of the universe, distant galaxies, and the future of space exploration, we aim to turn our ideas into innovative solutions. We believe that curiosity, creativity, and teamwork can help us overcome challenges and explore new possibilities. At this hackathon, we are ready to think beyond the horizon and reach for the stars!

SLO Sharks – Cosmic Ideas, Limitless Possibilities! 🚀🦈
